notes: HUNT H3 pair 4 (heat 2205, counter-layer x soul-static x cross-seat target). Malefic Scythe (seat 1) enters with its printed soul counter and equips seat 1's 3/3 Wolf (static +1/+1 per soul counter -> 4/4). Basri, Devoted Paladin (seat 0) +1 targets the ENEMY Wolf: 'put a +1/+1 counter on up to one target creature. It gains vigilance until end of turn' - target has no controller restriction (CR 115.7a / 601.2b; H2 cross-seat precedent), and equip/loyalty compile with timing None so the activation is legal in seat 0's own window. All three layers must STACK on the printed 3/3: +1 counter (CR 122.1c), +1 soul static (CR 613.3d) -> 5/5. The EoT vigilance clause is asserted IN the stamping window (H2 rig law 2: EoT effects expire on the turn dance). Counters lanes pin each layer separately so a collapsed total cannot pass: wolf PLUS_1_PLUS_1 1, scythe SOUL 1. Falsifiers: 4/4 (either the counter or the soul static blind), 5/4 or 4/5 (layer asymmetry), vigilance missing (EoT clause not stamped), loyalty 5 (+1 cost unpaid).
